name: Marine protected areas — fishing inside no-take reserves
description: 16 large no-take or strictly protected marine reserves (WDPA ids from WDPA v202512 via the GFW data API; extents from the GFW public-mpa-all polygons), tiled to ≤ 25 deg² (antimeridian-crossing reserves split). Rule mpa_fishing@1.0: ≥ 50 h of Global Fishing Watch apparent fishing in 30 days in a tile, confirmed when the same bar is met inside the legal polygon or the fishing persists a week later. Left out: Chagos/BIOT (not in the current WDPA/GFW MPA list), Ross Sea (circumpolar extent → ~35 tiles at 25 deg²), Natural Park of the Coral Sea (IUCN VI, < 1% no-take). Thresholds are starting points to tune against real sweeps.
